title: ochrosia parviflora
intro: Ochrosia parviflora, commonly known as the "Small-flowered Ochrosia" or "Small-flowered Ochrocarp", is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ochrosia parviflora include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, and show potential in the treatment of various diseases. Bioactive constituents of Ochrosia parviflora include alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
